results.title: Forging a solid foundation of unity under the rule of law embracing a brighter future through cooperation
results.description: On July 1st, the Ethnic Unity and Progress Promotion Law of the People’s Republic of China officially came into effect. results.title: Women of 'July Uprising' faded from Bangladesh's political and state structure after regime collapse: Report
results.description: According to a report by The Daily Star, women became a prominent presence across universities and campuses, leading slogans, blocking prison vans, rescuing the injured, providing medical care, and arranging food during the protests in July 2024.
